content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Charlotte

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm your background qualifies before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Over several weeks, you'll learn PMI's framework, practices, and exam domains from active certified practitioners—all online, on a schedule designed for working professionals in finance, healthcare, technology, and other Charlotte industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee to reserve your seat for the computer-based exam at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a local testing center and sit for the four-hour, 180-question computer-based PMP examination.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or certifications. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to employers.

fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
